params.name: blob
params.description: BLOB from which to get the Long Integer value

params.name: byteOrder
params.description: Byte ordering of the 4-byte value to read

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset within the BLOB (expressed in bytes); on return, incremented by the number of bytes read so it can be reused for the next read

overloads.semanticRole: Reads and returns a 4-byte Long Integer value from a BLOB at a given (or default) byte offset, honoring an explicit byte ordering, and advances the offset variable by the bytes consumed.

constraints: offset must be between 0 and (BLOB size - 4); otherwise error -111 is generated.
Byte-swapping across Macintosh/PC platforms is the caller's responsibility; this command does not perform it automatically beyond the byteOrder parameter.
